---
title: React SDK Quickstart
description: Install @personaai/react, wrap your app in PersonaProvider, and build working chat and workflow interfaces with streaming in under 100 lines.
---

`@personaai/react` is the official React SDK for [Persona](https://persona.hasanraiyan.me) — a
set of hooks and a context provider that let you build full-featured chat and workflow UIs against any
Persona backend without writing fetch calls, SSE parsers, or state management by hand.

**v0.9.0, current release.** Requires React 18+.

## Install

```bash
npm install @personaai/react
```

```bash
pnpm add @personaai/react
```

Peer dependencies: `react >= 18`. No other packages are required.

## Prerequisites

You need a running Persona backend — either:

- [`@personaai/adapters/nextjs`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index) mounted in your Next.js app
- [`@personaai/adapters/express`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index) mounted in your Express app
- [`@personaai/adapters/nestjs`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index) configured in your NestJS module
- A [raw runtime](/packages/runtime/v0.10.0/quickstart) on any other host

The React SDK is a **client-side** package. It calls your backend's HTTP routes (`/chat`,
`/workflows`, `/threads`, `/files`, `/memory`, `/health`, `/agents`) — it never talks directly to
persona.hasanraiyan.me or holds any credential.

## Set up the Provider

Wrap your app (or the subtree that needs chat / workflows) in `<PersonaProvider>`. It takes three things:

- **`baseUrl`** — where your Persona backend is mounted (e.g. `http://localhost:3000/api/persona`)
- **`getAuthToken`** — an async getter for the user's Bearer token (Clerk, JWT, session, whatever your app uses). Omit if your backend doesn't require auth.
- **`defaultAgentId`** — optional; lets you skip passing `agentId` to every hook call.

```tsx
// app/providers.tsx (Next.js App Router example)
'use client';

import { PersonaProvider } from '@personaai/react';

export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <PersonaProvider
      baseUrl="http://localhost:3000/api/persona"
      getAuthToken={async () => {
        const res = await fetch('/api/auth/token');
        const data = await res.json();
        return data.token;
      }}
      defaultAgentId="my-agent-id"
    >
      {children}
    </PersonaProvider>
  );
}
```

## Minimal Chat Example

```tsx
'use client';

import { useChat, useAgents } from '@personaai/react';

export function SimpleChat() {
  const { agents } = useAgents();
  const agentId = agents[0]?._id;

  const {
    messages,
    input,
    setInput,
    handleSubmit,
    isStreaming,
    error,
    stop,
  } = useChat({ agentId });

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div
            key={msg.id}
            className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-2 max-w-[80%] ${
              msg.role === 'user'
                ? 'ml-auto bg-blue-600 text-white'
                : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-900'
            }`}
          >
            {msg.content}
            {msg.isStreaming && <span className="animate-pulse ml-1">▊</span>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm">
          {error.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex gap-2 border-t p-4">
        <input
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Type a message..."
          className="flex-1 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2"
          disabled={isStreaming}
        />
        {isStreaming ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={stop}
            className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-white"
          >
            Stop
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="rounded-lg bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-white"
            disabled={!input.trim()}
          >
            Send
          </button>
        )}
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Workflow Execution Example

In `0.9.0`, you can execute and stream multi-step workflows with real-time step node progression:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useWorkflowStream } from '@personaai/react';

export function WorkflowRunner({ workflowId }: { workflowId: string }) {
  const {
    status,
    isRunning,
    activeNodeId,
    nodeRuns,
    output,
    error,
    start,
    cancel,
  } = useWorkflowStream(workflowId, {
    onNodeStarted: (node) => console.log(`Step started: ${node.nodeLabel}`),
    onNodeCompleted: (node) => console.log(`Step finished: ${node.nodeId}`),
    onFinish: (result) => console.log('Workflow complete:', result),
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => start({ query: 'Execute pipeline' })}
          disabled={isRunning}
          className="rounded bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {isRunning ? 'Running...' : 'Start Workflow'}
        </button>
        {isRunning && (
          <button
            onClick={cancel}
            className="rounded bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-white"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="text-sm">Status: <span className="font-semibold">{status}</span></div>

      {/* Node Progression Telemetry */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {Object.values(nodeRuns).map((node) => (
          <div
            key={node.nodeId}
            className={`p-3 rounded border text-sm flex justify-between ${
              node.nodeId === activeNodeId ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50' : 'border-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <div>
              <span className="font-medium">{node.nodeLabel}</span> ({node.nodeType})
            </div>
            <span className="capitalize text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded bg-gray-100">{node.status}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="text-red-600 text-sm">{error.message}</div>}

      {output && (
        <pre className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded text-xs overflow-x-auto">
          {JSON.stringify(output, null, 2)}
        </pre>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
